email.subject: Coverage needed in April
email.body:
Dear interpreters,

we would need your help to cover below hours in April. Please let me know if you could help to cover some hours.

* Monday-Wednesday: 11 am - 1 pm UK time

Please let me know if you would like to cover only specific dates or half an hour. Any help is highly appreciated!

Additionally, we have below availability for specific dates, all in UK time:

* April 8: 3-4 pm
* April 9: 10 am -12 pm and 1-2 pm
* April 21: 10-11 am
* April 23: 12-1 pm
* April 29, 30: 10-11 am

Thank you and best regards,
